assertion_analysis.failure_condition: Reverting the implicit tangent (deleting the _stationary_position call at nova/equilibrium/fixed_points.py:650) makes the JVP of a converged root zero while the central difference stays (0, 0.1), so the allclose at tests/equilibrium/test_certificate_550_convergence.py:41 and :115 reddens; the base-tree copy of the same test demonstrates exactly this (exports/carrier_tangent_base_final.log, jvp=[0. 0.] central=[0. 0.1], EXIT=1).

The two sides are independent sources - the left is jax.jvp through the code under test, the right is a central finite difference of the same code at h=1/4096 - so no assertion compares a value against the variable the test passed in; the guard at line 116 (abs(tangent[1]) > 0.05) additionally fails if the implicit solve returns a trivially zero tangent.

The node's own measure, the 550-cell row reaching 1e-12, is asserted nowhere in the landed tree: the surviving carrier test has no convergence assertion (docs/research/certificate-550-convergence.html:47 states so), so a regression that widens the stall would leave the after suite green on this node's target.

findings.text: follow-on: test_certified_limited_carrier_root_tangent loads the published 553-cell mesh but places a synthetic quadratic field and synthetic rows on it (lines 78-101) and asserts only the root tangent against a central difference (lines 115-116); it carries no assertion of the node's measure, so nothing in the suite reddens when the 550-cell convergence regresses further. The strict-xfail convergence assertion that commit 3bab5a7fe added (test_certified_limited_carrier_convergence_is_open at 3bab5a7fe, removed in e5ca25969) was the only executable record of the open stall, and after its removal the 1.2319931459852727 residual is documented in prose alone (docs/research/certificate-550-convergence.html:62). This holds no node: the coordinator asked for the tangent test rather than a convergence assertion.

follow-on: the recorded after_suite ran at revision 90829b93b (exports/after_suite.log:1), four commits and two test-file rewrites behind the reviewed head e21acb1e6, so its one failure - the setup error on test_certified_limited_carrier_root_tangent, a GPU-only subprocess run under the suite's CPU backend - is the added failure this record carries, and it measures a superseded fixture rather than the landed test file; the arm's PASSED counts likewise do not apply to the head. The head test does pass in the focused run (exports/carrier_tangent_head_final.log, EXIT=0), and the worker records the gap in the manifest, so the omission is disclosed rather than hidden.
